messages:
Maya C: Quick question — flying into PDX for the Portland offsite, any recs for getting to the Airbnb? carry-on only vs checking bags?
James R: TriMet MAX light rail from the airport is $2.50 and drops you pretty close to downtown. cheaper than an Uber but can be busy. :bus:
Li Wei: I did carry-on only last time and it made life so much easier. packable rain jacket + packing cubes = freedom. :umbrella:
Sofia G: If you have big suitcases, Uber/Lyft is way less painful. Also FYI the weather is still unpredictable in the evenings — plan layers.
Maya C: Nice — anyone got a tiny packing checklist I can crib?
Li Wei: sure, my 48hr offsite pack: ```- 2x shirts
- 1 light rain jacket
- 1 pair of nicer shoes (dinner)
- 1 pair comfy shoes
- chargers + USB-C multi-plug
- toiletries (travel size)
- packable daypack```
James R: Pro tip: keep a small clear zip bag for chargers at the top of your carry-on so TSA line is a breeze.
Sofia G: Also bring a reusable mug — great for coffee meetups and they have discount at some spots. :coffee:
Maya C: Does anyone want to do a group Lyft from PDX around 5pm on the 12th? cheaper to split + fewer trips.
James R: I can join, count me in. :thumbsup:
Li Wei: Probably in — tentative. If we do, maybe one person volunteer to be group lead to coordinate?
Sofia G: I can be lead. I'll create a short thread in the travel channel with driver ETA & pickup spot.
Sam (ops-bot): Reminder: offsite logistics doc updated with transit options + drop-off coordinates — https://redwood.example.com/offsites/portland (ops note)
Maya C: Awesome, thanks everyone. This helps a lot — feel less anxious already. :relieved:
